@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+import datetime
+from types import MappingProxyType
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import remove_values
+from ansible.module_utils import basic
+
+
+def test_remove_values_changes_only_string_values_and_preserves_container_types():
+    today = datetime.date(2020, 1, 2)
+    original = {'password': ('password twice password', 123, False, None, today),
+                'nested': [{'password-key': b'password'}]}
+    result = remove_values(original, iter((b'password',)))
+    assert result == {'password': ('******** twice ********', 123, False, None, today),
+                      'nested': [{'password-key': b'********'}]}
+    assert type(result['password']) is tuple
+    assert original['password'][0] == 'password twice password'
+
+
+def test_sanitize_keys_masks_nested_keys_and_honors_exclusions():
+    original = {'password': 'value', 'user-password-suffix': [
+        {'password': 1, 'password-key': 2, '_ansible_password': 3,
+         'changed': {'password': 4}}]}
+    result = basic.sanitize_keys(original, iter((b'password',)), frozenset(('changed',)))
+    assert result == {'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 'value',
+                      'user-********-suffix': [
+                          {'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 1,
+                           '********-key': 2, '_ansible_password': 3,
+                           'changed': {'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 4}}]}
+    assert result is not original
+    assert type(result['user-********-suffix']) is list
+
+
+def test_sanitize_keys_leaves_nonmapping_roots_unchanged():
+    for value in ('password', True, None, {'password'}, ['password'],
+                  ('password',), datetime.date(2020, 1, 2)):
+        assert basic.sanitize_keys(value, ('password',)) is value
+
+
+def test_both_sanitizers_handle_deep_mappings_without_recursion():
+    original = {'password': 'password'}
+    for _ in range(1200):
+        original = {'layer': original}
+    keys = basic.sanitize_keys(original, ('password',))
+    values = remove_values(original, ('password',))
+    for _ in range(1200):
+        keys = keys['layer']
+        values = values['layer']
+    assert keys == {'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 'password'}
+    assert values == {'password': '********'}
+
+
+def test_immutable_mapping_keeps_its_class_and_redacts_nested_content():
+    original = MappingProxyType({'password-key': {'password': 'password'}})
+    keys = basic.sanitize_keys(original, ('password',))
+    values = remove_values(original, ('password',))
+    assert type(keys) is MappingProxyType
+    assert keys['********-key'] == {'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 'password'}
+    assert type(values) is MappingProxyType
+    assert values['password-key'] == {'password': '********'}

+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.modules import uri
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('secrets, expected', [
+    ({'password'}, {'changed': False, '********_header': 'visible'}),
+    (set(), {'changed': False, 'password_header': 'visible'}),
+])
+def test_uri_sanitizes_response_keys_only_when_no_log_values_exist(monkeypatch, secrets, expected):
+    class Finished(Exception):
+        pass
+
+    class Module(object):
+        def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+            self.no_log_values = secrets
+            self.params = {'url': 'https://example.invalid', 'body': None,
+                           'body_format': 'raw', 'method': 'GET', 'dest': None,
+                           'return_content': False, 'creates': None, 'removes': None,
+                           'status_code': [200], 'timeout': 1, 'headers': {}}
+
+        def exit_json(self, **kwargs):
+            assert kwargs['changed'] is expected['changed']
+            assert kwargs.get('********_header', kwargs.get('password_header')) == 'visible'
+            assert ('********_header' in kwargs) == bool(secrets)
+            raise Finished()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(uri, 'AnsibleModule', Module)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(uri, 'uri', lambda *args: (
+        {'status': 200, 'password-header': 'visible'}, b'', None))
+    with pytest.raises(Finished):
+        uri.main()

@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+import datetime
+from types import MappingProxyType
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import remove_values
+from ansible.module_utils import basic
+
+
+def test_remove_values_changes_only_string_values_and_preserves_container_types():
+    today = datetime.date(2020, 1, 2)
+    original = {'password': ('password twice password', 123, False, None, today),
+                'nested': [{'password-key': b'password'}]}
+    result = remove_values(original, iter((b'password',)))
+    assert result == {'password': ('******** twice ********', 123, False, None, today),
+                      'nested': [{'password-key': b'********'}]}
+    assert type(result['password']) is tuple
+    assert original['password'][0] == 'password twice password'
+
+
+def test_sanitize_keys_masks_nested_keys_and_honors_exclusions():
+    original = {'password': 'value', 'user-password-suffix': [
+        {'password': 1, 'password-key': 2, '_ansible_password': 3,
+         'changed': {'password': 4}}]}
+    result = basic.sanitize_keys(original, iter((b'password',)), frozenset(('changed',)))
+    assert result == {'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 'value',
+                      'user-********-suffix': [
+                          {'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 1,
+                           '********-key': 2, '_ansible_password': 3,
+                           'changed': {'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 4}}]}
+    assert result is not original
+    assert type(result['user-********-suffix']) is list
+
+
+def test_sanitize_keys_leaves_nonmapping_roots_unchanged():
+    for value in ('password', True, None, {'password'}, ['password'],
+                  ('password',), datetime.date(2020, 1, 2)):
+        assert basic.sanitize_keys(value, ('password',)) is value
+
+
+def test_both_sanitizers_handle_deep_mappings_without_recursion():
+    original = {'password': 'password'}
+    for _ in range(1200):
+        original = {'layer': original}
+    keys = basic.sanitize_keys(original, ('password',))
+    values = remove_values(original, ('password',))
+    for _ in range(1200):
+        keys = keys['layer']
+        values = values['layer']
+    assert keys == {'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 'password'}
+    assert values == {'password': '********'}
+
+
+def test_immutable_mapping_keeps_its_class_and_redacts_nested_content():
+    original = MappingProxyType({'password-key': {'password': 'password'}})
+    keys = basic.sanitize_keys(original, ('password',))
+    values = remove_values(original, ('password',))
+    assert type(keys) is MappingProxyType
+    assert keys['********-key'] == {'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 'password'}
+    assert type(values) is MappingProxyType
+    assert values['password-key'] == {'password': '********'}

+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.modules import uri
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('secrets, expected', [
+    ({'password'}, {'changed': False, '********_header': 'visible'}),
+    (set(), {'changed': False, 'password_header': 'visible'}),
+])
+def test_uri_sanitizes_response_keys_only_when_no_log_values_exist(monkeypatch, secrets, expected):
+    class Finished(Exception):
+        pass
+
+    class Module(object):
+        def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+            self.no_log_values = secrets
+            self.params = {'url': 'https://example.invalid', 'body': None,
+                           'body_format': 'raw', 'method': 'GET', 'dest': None,
+                           'return_content': False, 'creates': None, 'removes': None,
+                           'status_code': [200], 'timeout': 1, 'headers': {}}
+
+        def exit_json(self, **kwargs):
+            assert kwargs['changed'] is expected['changed']
+            assert kwargs.get('********_header', kwargs.get('password_header')) == 'visible'
+            assert ('********_header' in kwargs) == bool(secrets)
+            raise Finished()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(uri, 'AnsibleModule', Module)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(uri, 'uri', lambda *args: (
+        {'status': 200, 'password-header': 'visible'}, b'', None))
+    with pytest.raises(Finished):
+        uri.main()
